## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/anonymous-gcrootlowering-cpp-/gcmachinecodeanalysis">GCMachineCodeAnalysis</a> - This is a target-independent pass over the machine function representation to identify safe points for the garbage collector in the machine code.</p>


<p>It inserts labels at safe points and populates a GCMetadata record for each function.</p>


<p>Definition at line 61 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/codegen/gcrootlowering-cpp">GCRootLowering.cpp</a>.</p>
